name: TEAM / Single 48 V 1000 W MY1020 + 36 V 20 Ah / chain-drive draft
notes: Separate single-motor alternative based on the current two-motor car. Keeps the steel/PVC frame, sensors, Ackermann steer-by-wire, THR-90 pedal, ESP32 boards and remaining systems. Uses the user-selected 48 V / 1000 W MY1020 motor ($82.89, shipping unknown), one mounting plate, a dedicated single-motor power stage and the linked 36 V / 20 Ah / 720 Wh battery. The motor and pack have different listed nominal voltages; electrical compatibility and available output require review. User selected chain drive to both rear wheels through an axle/differential; gearing and hardware selection remain open. Unknown engineering values remain blank.

architecture.wheel_connection: One motor through chain reduction to both rear wheels via axle/differential

custom_parameters.architecture_note: One user-selected 48 V / 1000 W motor drives both rear wheels via a chain and rear axle/differential. The selected pack is still 36 V / 20 Ah, so motor/controller compatibility and available output at that voltage are unverified. Retains the steel/PVC frame, Ackermann steer-by-wire, THR-90 pedal, ESP32 boards, sensors and remaining systems from the prior car. One motor mounting plate and a one-motor custom power stage replace their two-motor counterparts.
custom_parameters.regenerative_braking_note: Undecided. Confirm motor/controller support, battery/BMS charge acceptance and a back-drivable drivetrain before selecting regen. Mechanical brakes remain a separate required system.
custom_parameters.battery_selection_note: User-selected pack. The supplied Walmart title and indexed Walmart catalog list 36 V, 20 Ah, 720 Wh, a five-pin base, XT60, a 40 A BMS and a 5 A charger. The title also claims UL2271 certification and use with 0-1200 W bicycles; these are seller claims, not independently verified certification or system compatibility. The 40 A BMS label does not establish a continuous discharge rating; the 5 A charger does not establish a regenerative charge limit. Cell arrangement, usable capacity, continuous/charge limits, full-charge voltage, installed mass, dimensions and mounting remain unknown.
custom_parameters.drive_hardware_note: User-selected layout: one motor drives both rear wheels through a chain and rear axle/differential. This replaces the two independent direct wheel connections in the new car only. This aggregate includes the chain, motor and axle sprockets, tensioner, guard, differential, axle/half-shafts, bearings and retention hardware. It excludes separately listed motor, motor mount, wheels and frame. Chain pitch/length, sprocket tooth counts and ratio, differential and axle selection, alignment, load ratings, installed mass and price remain unknown. The 3D drawing is a proposed layout, not a fit-checked assembly.

conditional_component_notes.team-drive-option-belt-comet30: Alternative only if the current chain-to-axle/differential layout is changed to a compatible belt drive. Requires matching pulleys/torque-converter hardware and verified motor/axle attachment; fabrication may be needed. One offer contains two belts; installed quantity is undecided.
conditional_component_notes.team-drive-option-chain-sprocket: Candidate for the current one-motor chain drive to the rear axle/differential, pending chain pitch, tooth counts/ratio, shaft fit, length and load checks. If selected, price it within the existing drive assembly once; axle/differential, bearings, tensioner and guarding remain separate unknown costs.
